developmentFailures: Test helper TypeScript return type corrected before tests.
New positive tests identified period-before-newline denomination boundary and copy-exact Chinese denomination language-check compatibility; fixed before freezing v12.

limitations: Finite adjacent slash/每/per syntax, not arbitrary pricing-language parsing.
Carton may render as 中文箱; English carton and box remain distinct, bag never equates to box.
Unknown opaque denominators stay source-exact; kg/MT/lb and currency conversion rules unchanged.
Copy-exact denominator is validated before source-format restoration; no duplicate 每/per remains.
Original Low spacing/punctuation findings remain; no unrelated cleanup.
Synthetic rounds are not general accuracy; independent verifier must add at least five new cases.
No deployment, production settings, Firestore or LINE messages.
